clauses.spoken: A king risked his fortune to buy tomorrow.
He wanted the future all to himself.
Time considered the offer. The king added another coin.
Then another. Then the entire royal treasury.
At last, Time nodded, took the gold, and handed the king tomorrow.
The next morning, he woke to discover it was today.
He demanded his money back. Time said, I'm afraid your refund is due tomorrow.
